findings.title: the existing-repository push-guard upgrade is unreachable for any run past `planning`, and kernel.md claims otherwise
`orchid merge`'s containment warning has no opt-out, so a self-hosted repo prints it on every merge forever
the hook upgrade truncates in place and its failure message claims the older hook survived

summary: `_start_require_planning` (libexec/orchid-start:830) refuses before the new `orchid_install_push_guard` call at line 894, so the run-state refusal leg reaches an already-initialized repository only at
